method.shock: f = mean over 7 counting cats of actual/mu per team-week; Var(f) = shock^2 + mean(mean_c var/mu^2)/7 (cats independent under no shock, A2); shock = sqrt(excess); bootstrap SE over team-weeks
method.availability: pooled share of team games played per assumed tier, binomial SE; from report/accuracy.json
method.board_comparison: realized tier/healthy ratio, delta-method SE, beside deck, simulator and kit-board ratios; frozen preseason tags
method.inputs: data/weeks/week_N.json actuals; report/accuracy/lines_weekN.csv + state_weekN.json for the model
method.rosters: co_gm.team_roster since 2026-11-10: active players plus the team's unpooled players the week's lines carry (auto season lines). Weeks 1-3 have no such player, so their rows are as first fitted
